test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Saavaj is the official mascot of which of the following events?
solution:
The correct answer is __**36th National Games of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saavaj **is the official mascot of** 36th National Games of India.**
 
• The 36th National Games is drawing to a close, marking the culmination of a spectacular showcase of athletic prowess and the spirit of sportsmanship.
 
• **Gujarat **proudly hosted the National Games for the first time in 2022, with the event spread across six vibrant cities: Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, and Bhavnagar.
 
• Nearly 7,000 athletes from 28 Indian states, eight Union Territories, and the Services, including the sports teams of the Indian Armed Forces, vied for medals across 36 different sports.
 
• The Official mascot for the 36th National Games, "SAVAJ," embodies the most prominent qualities of a sportsman: self-confidence, vigor, unwavering motivation, a drive to succeed, focused determination, natural leadership, and the ability to set and achieve goals.
 
• In Gujarati, "Savaj-taranhar" translates to "Savior" in English. Savaj, representing the Asiatic Lion, serves as a poignant reminder of this majestic species, which now thrives solely in the wilds of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The 6th Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2023 **occurred from January 19–31, 2024, at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with additional venues in Madurai, Trichy, and Coimbatore.
 
• **The 2023 Men's FIH Hockey World Cup** was the 15th edition of the tournament, organized by the International Hockey Federation.
 
• **The Commonwealth Games **is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations, originating in 1930.
